title: PrT-Flow: Probability-Tractable Flow Matching for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17667v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models and Flow Matching can represent flexible distributions over robot actions, but many reinforcement learning algorithms also require the probability of each action. We introduce PrT-Flow (Probability-Tractable Flow Matching), which computes probability density while retaining multimodal, multi-step action generation. Its Jacobian-Tractable Transformer (JTT) makes each sampling step invertible and enables efficient computation of its Jacobian determinant. We train these finite steps with Conditional Euler-step Training (CET), which supervises their displacement over one step during sampling rather than their instantaneous velocity. We prove that, under certain assumptions, CET has the same minimizers as fitting the Euler-solver updates of Flow Matching. PrT-Flow achieves 96% success on Robomimic Lift after 300 epochs of imitation learning, matching the diffusion policy reference, and 96% success on OGBench Cube-Triple aft

translated_title: PrT-Flow：面向强化学习的概率可计算流匹配
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和流匹配能够表示机器人动作上灵活的分布，但许多强化学习算法还需要每个动作的概率。我们提出 PrT-Flow（概率可计算流匹配），它在保留多模态、多步动作生成能力的同时，还能计算概率密度。其雅可比可计算 Transformer（JTT）使每个采样步骤可逆，并能高效计算其雅可比行列式。我们采用条件欧拉步训练（CET）来训练这些有限步骤，该方法监督的是采样过程中单步的位移，而非瞬时速度。我们证明，在某些假设下，CET 与拟合流匹配的欧拉求解器更新具有相同的最小化解。PrT-Flow 在 Robomimic Lift 上经过 300 个 epoch 的模仿学习后达到 96% 的成功率，与扩散策略参考结果相当，并在 OGBench Cube-Triple 上达到 96% 的成功率……
tldr: PrT-Flow 通过雅可比可计算 Transformer（JTT）和条件欧拉步训练（CET），实现了既能计算动作概率密度、又保留多模态多步动作生成能力的流匹配方法，为强化学习提供了概率可求解的灵活动作分布建模。
en_tdlr: PrT-Flow introduces a probability-tractable flow matching framework using a Jacobian-Tractable Transformer and Conditional Euler-step Training, enabling efficient computation of action probability densities while retaining multimodal, multi-step action generation for reinforcement learning.
